description:
A powerful and easy-to-use screenshot/sticker tool that helps you improve efficiency


3.5.5.1
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Recording] Optimized performance resource usage for standard recording previews.
- [Editing] The “Edit” window now remembers the last‑selected always‑on‑top status.
- [Recording] Improved recording performance on Windows and macOS.
- [Recording] Increased the bitrate for screen recordings.
Bug Fixes
- [Annotation] Fixed a bug in the line‑wrapping logic for numbered annotations.
- [Recording] Fixed an issue where the screen recording timer included pause time.
- [Clipboard] Resolved a problem on macOS where clipboard content captured via PixPin could not be transferred to Windows devices using the WeChat input method.
- [Screenshot] Fixed an issue on macOS where switching between multi‑screenshot modes was unavailable when the focus was on the secondary display.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts] Fixed a bug preventing the Tab key from being assigned as a shortcut.
- [Table Recognition] Fixed discrepancies between the recognized number of rows and columns and the actual image.
- [Editing] Fixed a display issue with the toolbar when the “Edit” window is not set to always‑on‑top.
- [Save] Fixed inconsistent path symbol formatting on Windows.
- [Settings] Fixed scaling issues in the Windows settings interface.
- [Global Mouse] Fixed a bug on macOS that allowed the global mouse to be triggered by tap actions.
- [Performance] Fixed memory issues on macOS.
3.5.4.1
New Features
- [Formula Recognition] Added support for copying recognition results with Ctrl+C, and introduced a “Copy and Close” option.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts] In “Settings” → “Built‑in Shortcuts” → “Screenshot,” added a “Pause During Recording” action; the shortcut must be configured manually.
- [Annotation] Numbered annotations now include an arrow style.
- [Save] Expanded the range of variables available for save paths.
- [Annotation] In “Settings” → “Annotation” → “Serial Numbers,” added a “Global Sequence Count” option.
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Screenshot] Even when “Show Info Bar” is unchecked, the plus and minus icons remain visible in multi‑screenshot mode.
- [Trackpad] Reduced sensitivity when using the trackpad to navigate UI elements.
- [Sticker] Added a confirmation prompt to the “Destroy” option in both the system tray menu and the sticker right‑click menu.
Bug Fixes
- [Translation] Fixed errors in certain language pairs under the “Image to Image” translation mode.
- [Screenshot] Fixed an issue where pressing Esc sometimes failed to exit the screenshot interface.
- [Global Mouse] Fixed a bug where pressing a keyboard key would unexpectedly trigger the global mouse.
- [Screenshot] Fixed an issue where the screenshot interface did not display shortcut hints when the focus was on the secondary display.
3.5.3.0
New Features
- [Shortcut/Action] Added an action to “Hide Stickers Except the Currently Selected One.”
Settings Adjustments
- [Save/Copy] Changed “Quick Save Image Type” to “Image Type for Save/Copy.”
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Text Recognition] The punctuation options now remember the last selection.
- [Annotation] Optimized the usability of numbered annotations at smaller sizes.
- [Hardware Acceleration] Added a hardware test when enabling hardware acceleration.
Bug Fixes
- [Annotation] Fixed an issue where changing the annotation color using the color picker did not update the color in real time.
- [Annotation] Fixed a bug where the border could not be dragged when annotations were enabled.
- [Annotation] Fixed a displacement issue with text annotation boxes under certain conditions.
- [Auto Paste] Fixed an issue where “Automatically Paste Screenshot into Input Focus” did not work in the WeChat chat window.
- [Annotation] Fixed a bug where watermark annotations were not confined within the selection box.
3.5.2.2
New Features
- [Long Screenshot] In “Settings” → “Screenshot” → “Long Screenshot,” added a “Mouse Pass‑Through” option, which is enabled by default.
- [Table Recognition] Added a table recognition button to the editing window; to recognize tables in long screenshots, open the editing window.
- [Recording] If the app is unexpectedly closed during recording or playback preview, the recorded content will be restored upon next launch.
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Recording] Remembered the video quality setting used in the last export.
Bug Fixes
- [Keyboard Shortcuts] Fixed a bug where Ctrl+Tab had been registered as a global shortcut; it has now been moved to “Settings” → “Built‑in Shortcuts” → “Screenshot.”
- [Screenshot] Fixed an issue in multi‑area screenshot mode where deleting inner screenshot regions had no effect.
- [UI] Fixed several UI bugs.
3.5.1.0
New Features
- [Screenshot] Added multi‑screenshot mode, allowing switching between regular, polyline, freehand, and multi‑window screenshots. After pressing the screenshot shortcut, press Ctrl+Tab to change modes; hold Ctrl and tap Tab to cycle continuously.
- [Screenshot] Freehand screenshots let you draw a closed area along the mouse trail.
- [Screenshot] Polyline screenshots let you click points sequentially to define endpoints. Once at least three endpoints are set, right‑click to confirm the screenshot area; if fewer than three points are set, right‑clicking cancels the existing points.
- [Screenshot] Multi‑window screenshots capture multiple selected windows simultaneously.
- [Screenshot] All of these modes allow you to click the plus or minus icons in the upper left corner to add or remove screenshot areas, ultimately merging all captures into a single image.
- [Table Recognition] The recognition window’s right‑click menu supports operations such as merging and splitting cells, as well as deleting rows and columns.
- [Text Recognition] Added an option in the recognition window to “Highlight Corresponding Text in the Image When Selected”; this must be manually enabled.
- [Text Recognition] Added an option to “Automatically Copy Text When Closing the Window”; this must be manually enabled.
Settings Adjustments
- [Long Screenshot] In “Settings” → “Screenshot” → “Long Screenshot,” added a “Respond to Shortcuts” setting. When enabled, scrolling with the middle mouse button is disabled during long screenshots.
- [Polyline Screenshot] In “Settings” → “Screenshot” → “Polyline Screenshot,” added a “Polyline Corner Radius” setting to adjust the roundness of the corners.
- [Long Screenshot] Supports shadow and border settings, inheriting the relevant configurations from regular screenshots.
- [Long Screenshot] The border color matches that of regular screenshots.
- [Annotation] The maximum blur intensity has been adjusted to 50.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts] Shortcut assignment now supports the key combinations Ctrl+ScrLk and Ctrl+PauseBreak.
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Sticker] Even with thumbnails disabled, the right‑click menu still displays “Copy Original Image” and “Save Original as…” options.
- [Table Recognition] Recognition result files open with the device’s default application.
- [Translation] Clipboard‑based translations no longer display stickers during preset use.
- [Annotation] After drawing an arrow, the comment input field automatically gains focus.
Bug Fixes
- [Tip] Fixed an issue where Tips were not displayed consistently.
- [Export] Fixed a bug where minimizing the window during video export prevented reopening the interface.
- [Annotation] Fixed an anomaly in the display of numbered annotations on macOS with multiple monitors.
source: Shenzhen Shendu Tujing Technology Co., Ltd.
